rule: A hub, worker or host-local test file that mentions process.platform, darwin, launchd, launchctl, pmset, xcrun, node-pty, terminal-daemon, DaemonTerminalBackend or TerminalPool must be listed under subset or notPlatformSpecific, each with a reason. Enforced by scripts/check-macos-tests.mjs in pnpm lint.

subset.apps/hub/tests/build-output.test.ts: Checks the bundled node-pty prebuild and the terminal daemon entry in dist.
subset.apps/hub/tests/chat-continue-in-terminal: Real PTY through the production server.
subset.apps/hub/tests/cronjobs-via.test.ts: Real PTY through the production server.
Real PTY through the production server.
subset.apps/hub/tests/simulator-plugin.test.ts: Needs Xcode (xcrun simctl) and idb, only runs on darwin.
subset.apps/hub/tests/terminal-cold-restore.tes: Terminal daemon and PTY scrollback restore.
subset.apps/hub/tests/terminal-daemon-build-mis: Terminal daemon sockets, supersede and process liveness.
subset.apps/hub/tests/terminal-daemon-flood.tes: Terminal daemon flow control on a real socket and PTY.
subset.apps/hub/tests/terminal-daemon-nodepty-p: Daemon exit when node-pty fails to load.
subset.apps/hub/tests/terminal-daemon-restart.t: Shells that survive a server restart, process groups and signals.
subset.apps/hub/tests/pty-error-hints.test.ts: node-pty error text differs by platform.
subset.apps/hub/tests/host-battery-polling.test: Power state comes from pmset on macOS.
subset.apps/hub/tests/remote-host.test.ts: Remote worker with real terminals and the terminal daemon.
subset.apps/hub/tests/agent-idle-stop.test.ts: Process liveness checks and the terminal daemon helpers.
subset.apps/hub/tests/prune-missing-held-agents: Process liveness checks and held agent daemons.
subset.apps/hub/tests/dev-server.test.ts: Dev server child processes, process groups and the terminal daemon.
subset.apps/hub/tests/headless-hub.test.ts: Boots the hub and stops its terminal daemon.
subset.apps/hub/tests/provisioning.test.ts: Runs the provisioning shell script, which has launchd and systemd branches.

subset.apps/worker/tests/service.test.ts: Writes launchd plists and systemd units.
